test_objective: Verify system resilience on external service interruption (SMTP / LDAP / OAuth adapter #1).
preconditions: Simulated latency or socket disconnect on external gateway
test_steps: 1. Trigger event requiring external service dispatch (e.g. leave notification email, LDAP login)
2. Capture system log and user-facing error behavior
expected_results: System handles timeout gracefully without unhandled fatal crash; message queued for retry.
